$comment: Issue #103 — repo-controlled contact channel list. Edit this file when a channel is published, retired, or re-verified. Each channel is gated by `active` and `verified_at`; channels without a verified_at inside the freshness window (30 days, see schema.ts) are NOT rendered. Do NOT fabricate channels here — only list channels the operator actually publishes and stands behind at deploy time. The 'no fabricated affordance' rule (docs/personal/domain.md §11) is enforced by the schema's fail-closed gate.

channels.label: GitHub (rebuildup)
channels.$note: development-facing identity / repository namespace per docs/personal/domain.md §1 (rebuildup). Observable via the git remote URL in `.git/config`. Retired 2026-11-03 (Issue #832): the org profile is reachable (HTTP 200) but carries no contact affordance of its own — no issues, no discussions, no public address — so it was not a route a visitor could use to reach the owner. See docs/verification/contact/channel-verification-2026-11-03.md.

channels.label: GitHub (my-web-2026)
channels.$note: canonical source repository. Observable via the git remote URL in `.git/config`. Re-verified 2026-11-03 (Issue #832): HTTP 200, and the repository is a route a visitor can use — Issues and Discussions are both enabled (`has_issues: true`, `has_discussions: true`) and /discussions answers 200.

channels.$note: canonical personal domain per docs/personal/domain.md §1 and docs/personal/owner.md Identity summary. The 2025 edition remains published there. See docs/verification/contact/channel-verification-2026-11-03.md.
